project.name: rosetta
project.summary: Foundation i18n library family for source string collection, translation workflows, framework adapters, database helpers, documentation, tests, and release automation.
goals: Provide a lightweight, typed i18n library with source string collection and translation workflows.
Keep core package exports, Next.js/admin/database/translator adapters, docs, and tests coherent as one library family.
Publish only documented package exports and adapter contracts to consumers.
nonGoals: Own consumer application copy, translation policy, localization operations, or provider availability.
Own enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared CI and release policy.
Encode one product's copy workflow as hidden library behavior.

owns.name: rosetta-core-package
owns.description: Core @sylphx/rosetta package exports, string collection behavior, type contracts, and test coverage.

owns.name: rosetta-adapters
owns.description: Next.js, admin, Drizzle, and translator provider adapter packages with documented integration contracts.

owns.name: rosetta-docs-and-release
owns.description: Docs site, CI workflow, package build, and central release workflow wiring for the Rosetta package family.

doesNotOwn: Consumer application copy, translation policy, localization operations, provider availability, or product-specific workflow decisions.
Third-party LLM provider semantics beyond documented translator adapter behavior.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, rollout issue reconciliation, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit

forbiddenCouplings: Do not require consumers to import internal package paths instead of documented package exports.
Do not encode one consumer product's copy workflow or tenant policy as hidden Rosetta core behavior.
Do not bypass adapter boundaries for provider-specific translation behavior.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/.github.

delivery.deployPath: Pull requests and merge groups run .github/workflows/ci.yml; main pushes call .github/workflows/release.yml to delegate release handling to the central reusable workflow.
delivery.productionProof: Published package changes require CI evidence plus package/readback or consumer smoke proof for affected exports and adapters; this proof is not yet formalized as one release gate.

gaps.description: Upgrade from legacy CI to ADR-29 admission contexts when the package family is ready for full central policy enforcement.
Document package readback, docs readback, and consumer smoke evidence required after package releases.
Document supported translator provider contracts, failure modes, and adapter compatibility expectations.
